What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: Partially supported by NASA DEM (e.g., SRTM) for elevation and derived slope/flow metrics.
Required_primary_evidence: Use named DEM, resolution, CRS, flow-routing/TWI method and terrain quality; local field observations may capture bunds/drains the DEM misses.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Delete fixed baselines (elevation 18 m, slope 1.2%, TWI 10.4) as universal constants; no universal irrigation ban from slope alone.

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: SoilGrids supplies mapped sand/silt/clay and related estimates at 250 m; not NASA. Ribbon test supports only a texture-class observation.
Required_primary_evidence: Laboratory particle-size analysis for exact fractions. If SoilGrids is used, label mapped estimate and show depth/uncertainty.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Do not map each tactile class to exact sand/silt/clay %, bulk density, FC/PWP/AWC/Ksat/CEC or crop hard blocks.
Correct_data_label: Farmer observation / mapped estimate / lab measurement kept separate

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: SoilGrids predicts bulk density at 250 m as an external map; NASA satellite does not measure compaction in the field.
Required_primary_evidence: Use intact-core bulk density or repeatable penetrometer/profile assessment; distinguish surface tilth from subsoil hardpan.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Remove fixed +0.12/+0.22 g/cm3 shifts, rooting-depth caps and +15 bio-tillage bonus unless field-calibrated.
Correct_data_label: Measured bulk density / qualitative compaction flag

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: SoilGrids provides modeled water-content layers for named pressure conditions; NASA SMAP supports broad moisture context only.
Required_primary_evidence: Use lab pressure plate/membrane or a documented pedotransfer method, correct depth and coarse-fragment treatment; plant wilting days are confounded by crop/weather/root depth.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Remove deterministic conversions of 2–18 wilting days into precise AWC or blending guesses with formulas without calibration.
Correct_data_label: Modelled mapped water property / lab result / local estimate

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: No direct NASA field-scale Ksat measurement; imagery/moisture only provides indirect context.
Required_primary_evidence: Use double-ring infiltrometer/permeameter or a validated local method; ponding observations are screening flags not a numeric Ksat.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Remove fixed Ksat values assigned from soak-in hours and universal ECw/SAR penalty coefficients unless a source/validation supports them.
Correct_data_label: Field measurement or qualitative drainage-risk flag

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: DEM and NASA moisture/rainfall data can give landscape/climate context; neither directly measures the field water table.
Required_primary_evidence: Use soil profile, seasonal water-table observations/piezometer and local drainage records; define the scale of the decision.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Do not derive exact drainage class or water-table depth from surface satellite data alone.
Correct_data_label: Field profile / water-table observation + regional context

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: No reliable direct satellite measurement of hardpan/rooting depth; DEM is not a substitute.
Required_primary_evidence: Use soil profile pit/auger/penetration plus crop-specific rooting references; record soil depth by layer and actual restriction.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Remove universal rooting caps from qualitative observations unless measured and locally checked.

Section_Name: Soil reaction pH via weeds/leaf symptoms
What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: SoilGrids gives mapped pH estimate; NASA multispectral data cannot uniquely diagnose soil pH from weeds/leaves.
Required_primary_evidence: Soil pH lab method, sample depth, date and method; mapping as provisional prior when no test exists.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Do not translate a weed or leaf symptom directly into exact pH or hard pass/fail.

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: NASA reflectance may flag surface patterns associated with salinity after local calibration, but not direct root-zone ECe.
Required_primary_evidence: Use soil saturated-paste extract ECe with root-zone depth and method; retain EC1:5/ECa separately rather than silently converting.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Do not infer exact ECe from a visible crust or one vegetation signal; do not apply crop threshold from a different species.
Correct_data_label: Lab ECe or remote-sensing anomaly flag

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: Not directly measurable from NASA imagery.
Required_primary_evidence: Test exchangeable sodium and CEC for ESP, or water/soil solution ions for SAR; store units, extraction and sample date.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Remove universal empirical Ksat adjustment formulas absent validation; ESP and SAR are distinct quantities.

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: SoilGrids is not a direct universal CaCO3 lab substitute; GAEZ soil layers may support broad context only.
Required_primary_evidence: Use laboratory carbonate content or field test as qualitative screening, explicitly not exact percent.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: No exact CaCO3 percentage from fizz intensity without validated calibration.

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: SoilGrids maps SOC/CEC and related soil properties with uncertainty; it does not justify color-to-exact-number conversion.
Required_primary_evidence: Lab SOM/SOC and CEC methods; don't use fixed SOC-to-SOM factor without context.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Delete soil-color formulas returning exact SOM, SOC, CEC or coupled values without regional calibration.
Correct_data_label: Lab or mapped estimate; separate properties

Section_Name: Previous crop/leaf vigor => available mineral N
What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: SoilGrids total N is not plant-available nitrate+ammonium. NDVI anomaly is nonspecific.
Required_primary_evidence: Use time-stamped nitrate/ammonium soil test and crop-stage/management context; previous-crop N credit from a regional recommendation.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Do not convert crop appearance/preceding crop into exact NO3-N + NH4-N or universal signed kg N/ha effect.

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: No direct NASA measurement of Olsen P; vegetation indices are nonspecific.
Required_primary_evidence: Use a soil test with an appropriate extraction method. For critical values, require crop/soil/region calibration; Olsen commonly used in calcareous/alkaline soils.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Do not treat purple leaves as exact ppm or carry one critical value across all crops/regions.

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: No direct NASA measurement of exchangeable K; vegetation stress is not nutrient-specific.
Required_primary_evidence: Use NH4OAc-K lab method and regional/crop calibration; inspect other explanations for symptoms.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Remove exact K ppm estimates and universal clay thresholds based on symptoms.

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: HLS/NDVI can flag unusual canopy patterns; NASA imagery cannot confirm nematode/pathogen identity.
Required_primary_evidence: Use field scouting and diagnostic lab/extension identification; crop host range and rotation interval must be pathogen-specific.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Do not hard-code disease suppression/susceptibility or a universal return interval without a crop-pathogen reference.
Correct_data_label: Field diagnosis / lab confirmation / anomaly flag

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: NASA climate/rain/ET data can estimate demand and rainfall context, not actual water entitlement or delivered allocation.
Required_primary_evidence: Farmer/irrigation authority records, canal schedule, pumping limit and reliability; season and time horizon required.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Do not claim rainfall = irrigation supply or that ET estimates prove water savings.

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: Not directly measured by NASA Earth observation.
Required_primary_evidence: Water sample and lab analysis (ECw, ions/SAR, nitrate), sample date/source and seasonal variation.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: No crop suitability hard block based only on source label or unmeasured water quality.

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: NASA ET/land-surface data may contribute to area-scale context but does not directly measure applied irrigation efficiency for the field.
Required_primary_evidence: Capture irrigation system and scheduling; efficiency/amount requires local measurement or a sourced method; wetted fraction depends on geometry and crop stage.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: Do not presume system efficiency or convert method name directly into a precise water-savings score.

What_NASA_or_maps_can_support: NASA observations inform environmental conditions and historical crop/vegetation context; they do not certify biological crop parameters.
Required_primary_evidence: Use FAO-56 for ETo/Kc methods, FAO salt table only for exact species/end point, FAO Crop Calendar where records exist, GAEZ v5 for broad suitability, peer-reviewed/local sources for every other number.
Do_not_encode_without_evidence: All unsupported fixed values stay null/provisional; remove arbitrary +25 family bonus, generic N credits and undocumented 21-day sorghum rule.
Correct_data_label: Crop-parameter evidence registry with source per claim
